turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are you doing right now?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Pretty relaxed today.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It's supposed to be really hot tomorrow.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: How hot are we talking?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Close to a hundred, and I promised the kids an outing.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then maybe the pool, or somewhere indoors like a museum. Which would they enjoy more?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hang tight, my dad is calling me over. Don't talk until I say I'm back.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Of course.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Alex, which pillow do you use? Yours always looks so comfy.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: It's a memory foam one. I got it after my neck kept hurting.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Did it actually make a difference?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Honestly, yes. It took about a week to get used to it, but now I sleep way better.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hmm. Was it expensive?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Not bad. I can send you the link later.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'll be back in five, don't start the movie without me.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Okay, I'll wait.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Alright, I'm back now.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay. You were choosing between the pool and an indoor outing for the hot day.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Museum. My youngest burns way too easily.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sensible. Many museums have kids' areas, and you'll all stay nice and cool.
